blocks.text: These terms cover your use of the Quatlas Aeromodelling website. By using the site you agree to them; if you do not, please do not use it.
Use the site only for lawful purposes. Do not:

items: send content through our forms that is unlawful, abusive, harassing, defamatory or invades someone’s privacy;
send spam, unsolicited advertising or phishing messages;
interfere with or disrupt the site, its servers or the networks connected to it.

blocks.text: The contact, crowdfunding and recruitment forms ask for your name, contact details and, for students, your USN. We use them only to reply to you, to run recruitment, and to thank and update supporters. They are seen by the team’s core members and are never sold or shared outside the club. To have your details removed, email us.
All text, photos, drawings, logos and software on this site belong to Quatlas or the people who supplied them, and are protected by copyright and trademark law. Ask us before reusing them.
We may update these terms. The current version is always on this page, and continuing to use the site means you accept it.
Questions about these terms: aeromodellingquatlas@gmail.com, or Quatlas Aeromodelling, Ramaiah Institute of Technology, M S Ramaiah Nagar, Mathikere, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560054.
